prompt: Write 10 distinct short extracts of Larkmere Mutual's official guidance, procedures or policy wording about: hearing loss and phone calls. Two to four sentences each, in the society's own formal voice. Use type "fact". Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"If a member has difficulty hearing over the telephone, our colleagues will offer to continue the conversation in writing, by secure message or by another suitable channel.
